name: mast-services-finalize
description: Final operational step: assert that every MAST nssm service is Stopped and sits at the start mode provisioning owes it -- mast-unit Disabled (a running unit service commands hardware on process start, MAST_unit#132, with no interlock, so bringing the unit up is an operator's decision), the three prerequisite services Manual. The expected mode per service is the shared table in tools/mast-service-names.ps1, which mast-services-standdown (order 20) also reads. Runs last (order 9500, after all validation and the proxy finalize, before reboot detection) as the end-of-run posture check. The three prerequisite services join mast-unit at Disabled when the supervisor topology replaces them (#82); see issue #159.
